text:
The metal case of an electrical appliance is fitted with an earth connection.
What is the purpose of this?
A
to complete the circuit supplying the appliance so that it works
B
to ensure that the cables supplying the appliance do not become damp
C
to prevent the cables supplying the appliance from overheating
D
to protect a user of the appliance from electric shock

options.label: A
options.text: to complete the circuit supplying the appliance so that it works

options.label: B
options.text: to ensure that the cables supplying the appliance do not become damp

options.label: C
options.text: to prevent the cables supplying the appliance from overheating

options.label: D
options.text: to protect a user of the appliance from electric shock
